description: A PHP script for managing schema changes and migrations in the Revive Adserver project, including functions for retrieving change sets, handling user actions, and generating migration classes.

classes.name: Openads_Schema_Manager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing schema operations such as permission checks, migration class generation, and schema modifications.

methods.name: getLastChangeset
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent changeset filename from the changes directory.

methods.name: getChangesFile
methods.description: Determines the current changeset file based on cookies or default path.

methods.name: getSchemaFile
methods.description: Determines the schema file path based on cookies and changeset file.
